summary.headline: Christianbook secures $1.24 M in annual savings across five indirect spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped Christianbook, LLC drive measurable cost reduction in transportation, packaging, and merchant processing. Five sourcing events were completed and contracted, delivering a verified $1,237,359 in annual savings ― a 13–14 % reduction on $9.2 M of addressable spend. Key wins include 31 % savings on LTL freight by introducing a new carrier option, 10 % savings in merchant processing by moving to Calibr, and 14 % savings on corrugated packaging while retaining incumbents. All savings are now finalized and in effect, creating immediate EBITDA impact and stronger supplier partnerships for future growth.
